dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL-based system used in Japanese medical clinics
evidence: fixed-format with .CBL extension typical of JMA ORCA GnuCOBOL codebase

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical receipt (レセプト) creation and print instruction system; handles inpatient/outpatient receipt printing, prefecture classification, insurer number ordering, and job management for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software
purpose.summary: ORCGR02 is a receipt creation and print-instruction program (component R02) within the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It manages screen-based selection of print parameters (print order, prefecture classification, receipt type, insurer number range) and dispatches print jobs for medical insurance claim receipts. It includes preview functionality, re-print capability, and handles both inpatient and outpatient receipt categories.

notable_features: 43 COPY statements referencing JMA ORCA-specific copybooks (.INC files)
OCCURS clauses with nested tables (SPA-GMN-TBL, SPA-NAI-TBL)
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
File STATUS handling for error file (RECEERR-FILE)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary JMA ORCA middleware
Screen SPA (Scratch Pad Area) pattern typical of JMA ORCA online programs
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text, causing mojibake in the transcription. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA (日医標準レセプトソフト) system running on GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 180120 bytes total; full procedure division not visible but indicators confirm production-grade complexity.
